svg.title: The order the search returns
svg.desc: Three ranked lists of the same nine stored facts, each with a line after the sixth row. First list, the example's question scored by embedding similarity only: Lena and shellfish 0.743, Jonas and coeliac 0.736, the dinner plan 0.729, Indian food 0.680, the budget 0.663, the peanut allergy 0.612, then below the line Kreuzberg 0.609, the replaced fact 'strict vegetarian' 0.589 and the fact that replaced it 0.589. Second list, the same question with keyword scores added: Jonas 0.555, the dinner plan 0.446, Lena 0.394, Indian food 0.362, the fact that replaced the old one 0.357, the budget 0.354, then below the line the peanut allergy 0.306, Kreuzberg 0.305 and the replaced fact 0.295. Third list, the question 'what should I cook tonight?': Indian food 0.643, the budget 0.586, the dinner plan 0.572, the fact that replaced the old one 0.551, Kreuzberg 0.548, Lena 0.547, then below the line the replaced fact 0.545, Jonas 0.540 and the peanut allergy 0.509, in last place.
